name: Operation Baltic Shield
description: EFDL Sector Latgale — autonomous unmanned engagement area defense against Russian mechanized forward detachment in open terrain
problem_statement: Employ autonomous ground platforms in the Unmanned Engagement Area to detect, track, and attrit Russian forward detachment to <30% combat power before manned defenders engage

name: ISR Collection — Narva Sector
description: Persistent ISR coverage of the Estonia-Russia border at Narva using networked autonomous sensors and Five Eyes intelligence sharing
problem_statement: Provide continuous ISR coverage of Russian Western Military District movements to support EFDL early warning across the Estonian sector

name: Suwalki Corridor Defense
description: Defense of the Suwalki Gap — preventing Russian/Belarusian forces from severing the land link between Poland and the Baltic states
problem_statement: Defend the 65km Suwalki corridor to maintain NATO's land line of communication to the Baltic states

name: Counter-EW Operations
description: Electronic warfare countermeasures — maintaining autonomous platform communications and GPS navigation under Russian EW suppression
problem_statement: Ensure autonomous platform mesh network resilience and navigation accuracy under active Russian electronic warfare jamming

name: Logistics Corridor — Poland to Latvia
description: Sustainment operations supporting EFDL forces via the Via Baltica corridor from Poznan through Lithuania to Latvia
problem_statement: Sustain forward-deployed EFDL forces via secure logistics corridor while maintaining Suwalki Gap transit capability
